nl-allergen-order.summary: Requires a plain statement of named allergens on the front or back of the pack.
nl-allergen-order.impacts: Every pack that contains a named allergen needs a revised label.
nl-allergen-order.implications: Label artwork and print runs must change before the effective date.
nl-allergen-order.action: Inventory allergen content by product and schedule label updates.

nl-colorant-guidance.summary: Asks producers to stop using a listed set of colorants by the end of the year.
nl-colorant-guidance.impacts: Products that use a listed colorant are named in follow-up reviews.
nl-colorant-guidance.implications: A colour change is also a claims event, not only a recipe change.
nl-colorant-guidance.action: List colorant sources by product and route any swap through claims review.

sv-origin-labeling.summary: Restricts when a pack may say it is a product of Southvale.
sv-origin-labeling.impacts: Packs that make an origin claim need documented ingredient sourcing.
sv-origin-labeling.implications: Sourcing records become part of label approval.
sv-origin-labeling.action: Collect supplier origin statements for products that make the claim.
